title: WORKSHOP-COURSE/1 with structured-2 teaching traces, persistent source and typed executable questions
description: A curriculum data contract with persistent course/lesson reference code, line- and literal-span-focused blocks, native teaching traces and typed question inputs. Source is displayed as data unless a short-answer question explicitly configures execution. HTML/SVG presentations remain in the isolated offline client sandbox; publication and progress storage do not execute source.
$comment: MaxLengths are additionally enforced in UTF-16 code units by the server and Swift client. JSON Schema counts Unicode code points. The API also enforces the 1 MiB UTF-8 document limit, global case-insensitive UUID uniqueness, code line references, table row widths and option references. Question maxLines >= minLines and matching explicit input/execution languages are checked by the server and Swift client.

code.$comment: Line numbers must not exceed the number of CRLF/CR/LF-delimited source lines; annotation.line must be unique. The API performs these semantic checks.

table.$comment: Every row must contain exactly as many cells as columns; the API enforces this cross-field rule.

choiceBlock.$comment: Option IDs must be unique and correctOptionIDs must reference existing options; the API checks these relations.

trace.$comment: Author-written teaching frames; never a claim that source was compiled. Variant IDs and per-frame object IDs must be unique. Frame.line must reference a source line in its variant. The API performs these semantic checks.

questionInput.$comment: When both line limits are provided, maxLines must be at least minLines; checked by server and client.

execution.$comment: Only explicit short-answer execution is enabled. Template substitutes exactly one {{ANSWER}} and is required for non-code inputs. The input and execution languages must match when both are specified.

focusLines.$comment: Nonempty lines must fit the effective visible source: current block.code, presentation.code, trace first variant.code, execution.template, lesson.referenceCode, course.referenceCode, closest preceding code-bearing block, or first following code-bearing block within the same lesson. The server/client check source bounds; an empty array may clear highlighting without code. Supplying block.focusLines or block.focusSpans replaces both source default highlights, treating the omitted other field as empty. Neither field inherits highlights from a neighboring legacy source. Nonempty active trace frame.focusSpans take precedence at runtime, otherwise frame.line is highlighted.

codeSpan.$comment: Exact case-sensitive literal text; no Unicode normalization or regular expressions. occurrence counts left-to-right non-overlapping matches on one CRLF/CR/LF-normalized line and defaults to 1. The selected occurrence must exist in the effective code source.

codeSpans.$comment: The API additionally rejects duplicate line/text/(occurrence or 1) tuples, so omitted occurrence and explicit 1 are equivalent. Different spans may overlap and render as their union. Empty arrays are allowed without a code context. Code.highlightSpans reference own source; block.focusSpans use the effective visible source; trace frame.focusSpans reference its variant source. Nonempty frame spans replace frame.line highlighting; omitted/empty spans use frame.line.
